# Issue Guidelines

Thank you for contributing to **Mandelbrot Fractal Neural Synthesis**!

Please use our structured issue templates:
- [🐛 Bug Report](https://github.com/pCwOrM/mandelbrot-fractal-neural-synthesis/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
- [💡 Feature Request](https://github.com/pCwOrM/mandelbrot-fractal-neural-synthesis/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)
- [🔬 Empirical Replication Report](https://github.com/pCwOrM/mandelbrot-fractal-neural-synthesis/issues/new?template=replication_report.yml)

For general questions and theoretical discussions, please visit [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/pCwOrM/mandelbrot-fractal-neural-synthesis/discussions).
